use_case_title: Mainframe COBOL Modernization and Developer Productivity with AMI DevX
description: Modernize COBOL-based mainframe applications while addressing skills gaps by adopting AMI DevX tooling, enabling faster, safer code changes and improved developer productivity. This also supports structured migration of selected workloads to other platforms as agencies like Texas DPS plan to sunset mainframe footprints.

use_case_title: Mainframe Security, Resiliency, and Compliance for DIR Mandates
description: Enhance mainframe cybersecurity posture, resiliency, and disaster recovery to meet DIR mandates by replacing legacy IBM security tools with BMC AMI Security and standardizing controls across DIR, Texas CPA, and Atos-managed environments. This reduces risk and helps agencies comply with statewide security and audit requirements.
ppt_source_file: FY26 State of Texas 10X Mindset - Jeff Ebbrecht AM 08292025.pptx

use_case_title: Mainframe Operations Automation and Cost Optimization with AMI Ops
description: Automate and optimize mainframe operations using BMC AMI Ops and AMI Ops Automation to improve performance, capacity utilization, and cost transparency on shared mainframe services. The goal is to "do more with less" by reducing manual effort and avoiding unnecessary infrastructure spend.
ppt_source_file: FY26 State of Texas 10X Mindset - Jeff Ebbrecht AM 08292025.pptx

use_case_title: AI-Driven Mainframe Observability and Anomaly Detection with AMI Ops Insights
description: Deploy AMI Ops Insights to provide AI/ML-driven observability for mainframe operations at agencies such as Texas CPA, enabling proactive anomaly detection, faster incident resolution, and continuous performance optimization. ppt_source_file: FY26 State of Texas 10X Mindset - Jeff Ebbrecht AM 08292025.pptx

use_case_title: Hybrid Cloud Integration and Mainframe Data Modernization with AMI Cloud, AMI Data, and Control-M
description: Use AMI Cloud and AMI Data to integrate mainframe data and services with public cloud platforms like AWS and Azure, enabling modern analytics, DataOps, and governance across agencies. Orchestrate these hybrid workloads end-to-end with Control-M to provide a unified operational view spanning mainframe and cloud environments.

use_case_title: Broadcom/CA and IBM Mainframe Toolchain Takeout and Consolidation at DIR
description: Consolidate Broadcom/CA and IBM mainframe management tools under the BMC AMI/IZOT suite within DIR and Atos-run environments, simplifying the toolchain and vendor landscape. This takeout reduces licensing and support costs while delivering a more modern, integrated mainframe operations platform.
ppt_source_file: FY26 State of Texas 10X Mindset - Jeff Ebbrecht AM 08292025.pptx

use_case_title: Mainframe Storage and Virtual Tape Modernization with AMI Cloud and S3 Storage
description: Modernize mainframe storage, virtual tape libraries, and tape management at Texas CPA and DIR (via Atos) by replacing IBM storage and VTL solutions with AMI Cloud-backed, S3-compatible storage architectures. This improves scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency for backup, archival, and recovery workloads on the mainframe.

use_case_title: Legacy Workload Scheduler Replacement and Standardization on Control-M
description: Standardize enterprise workload automation on Control-M across state agencies by displacing legacy schedulers such as Broadcom/CA JobTrac at the Texas Railroad Commission and ActiveBatch at Texas HHS, and by reclaiming Control-M in Accenture-managed environments. This delivers consistent orchestration, governance, and reliability for cross-agency batch and data workflows.
ppt_source_file: FY26 State of Texas 10X Mindset - Jeff Ebbrecht AM 08292025.pptx

use_case_title: Control-M SaaS Migration and Onboarding of New SaaS-Orchestrated Workloads
description: Migrate existing on-premises Control-M deployments at TxDOT, Texas CPA, and Texas HHS to Control-M SaaS while onboarding new workloads for the Texas Railroad Commission and DIR/HHS.
